name: Reconstructing a Death Scene
hint_layers: Use the watch on a corpse or trace.
Listen before looking; the pre-death audio often gives names or context.
After entering the frozen scene, inspect positions, uniforms, weapons, and sight lines.
solution: Use Memento Mortem on a corpse, listen to the final audio, inspect the frozen scene, then record identity and fate evidence in the logbook.

name: Identifying the Sixty Souls
hint_layers: Do not solve one person in isolation; solve clusters.
Use jobs, nationalities, ranks, relationships, and who appears together.
When three fates lock in together, use that confirmation to narrow the next group.
solution: Combine the roster, sketches, deck plans, dialogue, and death scenes to determine each person's name, fate, killer or location if alive.

name: Low-Spoiler Deduction Assistance
hint_layers: Ask for the chapter, corpse, or page number before giving an identity.
Prefer evidence categories over final names.
Only reveal a name or fate when the player explicitly asks for the answer.
solution: For low-spoiler help, return evidence prompts and elimination logic rather than the final identity or fate.
